This product is connected to audio and video signal sources, such as cameras, and camcorders through the HDMI interface, and transmits it to a device with a USB or type C interface for the recording. Great for you to record videos & audio clearly at any time for storage to view in the future.
*Dual Interface Apply to both Phone and Computer: With USB-A & USB-C dual interface design, this capture card for streaming can compatible with most current laptops, tablets, mobile phones, cameras, webcams and other devices. No need to carry adapters with different interfaces, compact and portable.
*Plug and Play, Driver-free: No driver required and no external power supply, just connect and start high-definition reproduction of videos. Aluminum-alloy shell, make sure a longer use life. This 4k capture card weighs only 19.9g, making it light and portable.

Real-time recording and collection of important meetings or courses for easy review. The latest design of the 4K capture card allows you to enjoy ultra-low latency during live gaming or video recording, avoiding freezing and blue screens.
*Wide Compatibility: This HDMI capture card can be working on several operating systems: compatible with Windows 8.1/10, Linux, and Android. description:
*EXTEND YOUR 3.5MM AUX PORT: Ugreen 3.5mm audio extension cable extends the connection between your iPhone, iPod, MP3 players, smarphones, tablet or any other 3.5mm aux port equipped devices to your headphone, earphone, speaker, car stereo or home theater system etc.

Important Notes: If you use TRRS headphones (4-conductor) with this extension cable, the audio will work but the Mic won't.It also does NOT work with the inline volume control on the headphone.

The solid shieldings protect the audio against RF, EM, and ground loop interference during transmission and provide noise-free and ultra-clear sound quality.
*Enhanced Durability & Flexibility: The 90 Degree 3.5MM to 3.5MM Audio Cable features flat design to avoid tangles and kinks. The soft TPE jacket makes this stereo aux cable much easier to roll up for storage. product_name: HiTune Max 5C Hybrid Active Noise-Cancelling Headphones
description:
Advanced Hybrid Active Noise Cancellation: UGREEN Noise Cancelling Headphones features both Adaptive ANC (Active Noise Cancellation) and physical noise isolation, achieving up to 43dB deep noise reduction for enhanced audio clarity. Equipped with an AI-powered noise-cancelling chip, this Over-ear Headphones intelligently separate ambient noise in real time, pick up clear human voice while making mic call, and allow you be clearly heard in any environment.
Hi-Res Certified & Spatial Sound: With Hi-Res audio certification, UGREEN Over-ear Nosie Cancelling Headphones supports 96kHz/24-bit audio with a bit rate of 990kbps, providing a sound experience that is richer in information, clearer in detail and better in reproduction. The Bluetooth Wireless Earphones supports spatial audio for a full 360° immersive listening experience. Feature a 40mm dynamic driver to provide deeper, more refined bass performance.
LADC Audio Codec & Dual Pairing: The Over-ear Wireless Headphones adopt Bluetooth 5.4 technology and support LDAC decoding format, which reduces audio latency to as low as 80ms while minimizing audio loss during transmission—allowing you to enjoy Hi-Res Audio wirelessly. The Bluetooth ANC Headphones also support AAC and SBC codecs, and enable dual-device connectivity for seamless switching between devices.
Customizable EQ via App: UGREEN Bluetooth Wireless Earphones support EQ adjustment through a dedicated app, allowing to personalize sound profiles. The over ear earphones feature 8 preset EQ, 3 ANC modes, Game Mode, Dual Connection, Hi-Res & Spatial sound effect setting, and battery checking. The APP makes it convenient to control this wireless headphones.
45H/75H Extended Battery Life: UGREEN Noise Cancelling Bluetooth Earphones feature 600mAh battery to realize 75 hours of playback with ANC off and 45 hours with ANC on, ensuring all-day usage without frequent recharging.
USB C Wired Audio & Charging: UGREEN Over-ear Bluetooth Headphones features a USB-C port for fast charging and audio input. Use the included USB C to USB C cable to connect this wireless earphones to a phone/tablet/laptop for charging or wired audio connection. The USB-C port also supports Hi-Res audio. Designed with physical buttons for intuitive control of playback, volume, ANC modes.
Comfortable & Secure Fit: Crafted with soft, skin-friendly materials, weighing only 264g, UGREEN Active Noise Cancellation Headphones offer long-wearing comfort. The ear cups are adjustable, foldable, and extendable, making them ideal for various head sizes and easy to carry on the go.
short_desc: Over-ear headphones with hybrid ANC up to 43dB and Hi-Res.

【Say Goodbye to Noise】Whether you are commuting, working, traveling, or studying, UGREEN wireless headphones can provide you with an immersive personal audio space. Our bluetooth headphones are equipped with A-level ANC technology (Adaptive Noise Cancellation) which can automatically adjust the noise reduction effect according to the noise in the surrounding environment, providing a more intelligent and personalized noise reduction experience.
【Comfortable Wear for Long Use】UGREEN noise-cancellation headphones (260g) are lighter than most headphones, which will not put too much pressure on the head when worn. The earmuffs are made of skin-friendly protein leather, which is soft and elastic, protecting your ears from damage. Max 6 headphones fit snugly in your ears, making them perfect for both exercise and long-time work.
【Ultra-long Battery Life & Fast Charging】The over-ear headphones can be fully charged in just 2 hours. With long battery life (120 hrs-ANC Off, 80 hrs-ANC On), UGREEN headphones can be used for a week after a single charge in case of frequent use and even for two weeks in case of casual use. With just 10 minutes of charging, the earphones can be used continuously for 5 hours.
【Clear and Smooth Call】Equipped with an upgraded AI intelligent noise reduction chip, the wireless headsets can effectively separate environmental noise and human voice, filter out noise, and retain pure human voice. The built-in microphone can pick up sound accurately, ensuring that you and the person you are talking to can hear each other clearly.
【Connect Dual Devices Simultaneously】With our APP, the over-ear bluetooth headphones can connect two devices at the same time, which means that you can freely switch between two devices. Note: The device dual connection is disabled by default, and users need to enable it through the APP.

description:
Powerful Sound & Clear Call: UGREEN Wireless Bluetooth Headphones feature feedforward active noise cancellation (ANC) to reduce low-frequency ambient noise—like air conditioners and traffic—by up to 25dB, delivering clean, distraction-free audio. The ANC Over-ear Headphones adopt an AI-powered noise-canceling microphone system to capture your voice and filter out backgroud sound in real time, ensuring crystal-clear calls even in noisy environments.
Immersive Spatial Audio: Equipped with 30mm titanium-coated composite drivers, UGREEN Noise Cancelling Wireless Headphones deliver crisp highs, clear mids, and deep, rich bass. Enhanced with spatial audio technology, the ANC Headphones provide immersive cinematic listening experience. Ideal for podcasts and audio books.
0.08S Ultra-Low Latency & Multi-Point Connection: Powered by Bluetooth 6.0, supporting AAC and SBC codecs plus BLE/SPP protocols, UGREEN Noise Cancelling Over-ear Headphones offer ultra-low latency (as low as 0.08 seconds) and minimal audio loss—ideal for gaming and video. The Wireless Headphones support multi-point pairing, allowing you to connect to two devices simultaneously (e.g., phone and laptop) and switch seamlessly between them.
Customizable Control via Smart APP: UGREEN APP makes it more simple to use these Active Noise Cancelling Headphones. Choose from 8 preset EQ modes or fine-tune your sound profile. Use the app to enable ANC, spatial audio, and multi-device pairing, or customize the physical button functions to match your preferences.
80H Long-Lasting Playtime: UGREEN Over-ear Bluetooth 6.0 Headphones feature 500mAh battery to deliver up to 80 hours of playback on a single charge. With ANC on, up to 55 hours. The ANC Wireless Headphones feature a USB C fast charging port to get a full recharging with 1.5 hours. Perfect for travel and daily use.
Comfortable & Secure Fit: Combined soft, skin-friendly materials, ultra-lightweight design(only 135g) with small ear cups, UGREEN ANC Over-head Headphones offer long-wearing comfort. The ear cups are adjustable & rotatable, and the handband is extendable, making this wireless bluetooth earphones ideal for various head sizes and easy to carry on the go.

description:
【High Speed Cat7 Ethernet Cable】 Ugreen Gigabit Ethernet Cable supports data transmission rate up to 600MHz, much faster than Cat 5 (100 MHz) or Cat 6 (250 MHz). And the syncing speed up to 10Gbps.
【Universal Compatibility】 The lan patch cord is compatible with all RJ45-enabled devices such as imac pro, Nintendo Switch, computer, game consoles, Xbox, PS3, PS4, TV Box, Freebox, Network Printers, Switches, Modem, Routers, POE Deviecs and more.
【Better Shielding】 This RJ45 patch cable are Made of 4 shielded twisted pair (STP) of copper wires with two RJ45 connectors on each end. Compared to the Cat 6 network Ethernet cable, the additional shielding and improved quality in twisting of the wires provides better protection from crosstalk, noise, and interference that can degrade the signal quality.
【Easier to Manage】 Compared with round lead, flat ethernet cable not only helps you to avoid tangled cords and saves space, but also makes it easier to manage cable when run under the carpet, doors, rotating arms and drawers or along walls.
【Efficient Network Life】With this Cat 7 network cable, it's easier to guarantee high-speed data transmission for cloud storage, server application, online gaming, online video streaming etc.You could enjoy a super fast ethernet speed whether at home or office.
short_desc: Cat7 flat ethernet cable, 600MHz and 10Gbps, shielded copper.

description:
*More and more new launched laptop, ultrabook will equipped with USB type C port rather than standard USB A port. We enjoy the portable super thin design. But soon find it a little annoyance and lower our work efficiency, since we could not use the standard USB mouse, flash drive on the type C MacBook or Ultrabook directly.
*This little gadget will tackle the problem, adding a USB A port to USB C enabled devices, so that you can connect standard USB peripheral, such as flash drive, USB Hub, printer cable, card reader, keyboard or mouse etc to your USB c Smartphone, tablet, MacBook, laptop for data transmission.
*For USB C OTG Supported phones, this converter can turn your phone as a host, then you can enjoy movies or music directly from your USB flash drive. You can also gaming with a USB game handle, typing with a keyboard etc. Much more convenient operation bring better working and entertainment experience.
*Note
1. For a better using experience, we suggest to use this product for data transferring but not for charging.
2. For OTG function, please make sure that your device is OTG Supported.
3. For Nintendo Switch, OTG function is available to attach a mouse or keyboard but not a flash drive / HDD to Nintendo Switch
short_desc: USB-C to USB 3.0-A OTG adapter adds a USB-A port.
